_comment: Copy this to %USERPROFILE%\.filearchives\workspace.json and edit it,
or point FILEARCHIVES_WORKSPACE at a copy for a one-off run against
another drive. It is NEVER committed: it describes one person's machine.
There is deliberately no default. A machine without this file stops with
instructions rather than inventing D:\ and writing records somewhere
audit    - where the engine writes its own records and journals
sources  - read-only trees to survey and ingest FROM. May include peers
that are not always mounted: an absent source is reported and
skipped, never silently treated as empty.
protected_roots - exact trees the engine must never enter
protected_names - optional path-segment names to exclude everywhere
